# Bravura Glyph Paths

`src/bravura_glyphs.rs` contains flag and rest outlines extracted from Bravura 1.482 for self-contained SVG rendering. The outlines are redistributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see [OFL.txt](OFL.txt).

Source font: [Bravura 1.482](https://github.com/steinbergmedia/bravura/tree/bravura-1.482), pinned commit `37b194378b710cc40e406ab6c4b07608bb9548ae`, asset `redist/otf/Bravura.otf`.

Copyright 2015 Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH. Reserved Font Name: Bravura.

The original font file is not included. The renderer uses only the path data and does not install, embed, or require Bravura at runtime.
